name: Taming the Beast
label: Quest
description: Quel'ana Quickgale sets you a final trial in taming a Vuldren Alpha. Mastering it prepares you to learn the deeper ways of your class.
intro: Quel'ana Quickgale sets you a final trial in taming a Vuldren Alpha. Mastering it prepares you to learn the deeper ways of your class.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead.
Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery.
Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the adventurer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.
Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the adventurer that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
